local Money = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MonetizationConfig"))
local U = {}

U.MAX_LEVEL = 12

U.PEN = {
    name = "Pen", title = "Upgrade Pen",
    icon = "rbxassetid://87422007868226",
    base = 1e5, growth = 8,
    petsBase = 3, petsPerLevel = 1,
    robux = Money.UPGRADES.PEN.prices,
    productIds = Money.UPGRADES.PEN.productIds,
}

U.MILL = {
    name = "Treadmill", title = "Upgrade Treadmill",
    icon = "rbxassetid://83769600890897",
    base = 2.5e5, growth = 9,
    awardBase = 4, awardEvery = 0.5, awardGrowth = 2,
    robux = Money.UPGRADES.MILL.prices,
    productIds = Money.UPGRADES.MILL.productIds,
}

function U.price(kind, level)
    local d = U[kind]
    if not d then return math.huge end
    return math.floor(d.base * d.growth ^ (math.max(1, level) - 1))
end

function U.petCap(level)
    local lv = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
    return U.PEN.petsBase + (lv - 1) * U.PEN.petsPerLevel
end

function U.robux(kind, level)
    local d = U[kind]
    if not d then return 0 end
    return d.robux[level] or d.robux[#d.robux]
end

function U.productId(kind, level)
    local d = U[kind]
    return d and tonumber(d.productIds[level]) or 0
end

return U

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")

local world = workspace:WaitForChild("GameWorld")
local template = game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild("AdminTreadmillTemplate")
local U = require(RS.UpgradeConfig)
local Cfg = require(RS.EggConfig)

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "AdminTreadmillExit"
remote.Parent = RS.Remotes

local REENTER_COOLDOWN = 1.5
local STAND_HEIGHT = 7
local RUN_REFERENCE = 20

local function rateFor(p)
	local walk = Cfg.walkForSpeed(p:GetAttribute("Speed") or Cfg.SPEED_START)
	return math.clamp(walk / RUN_REFERENCE, 0.7, 3.5)
end

local sessions = {}
local lanes = {}
local cooldown = {}
local activeModel, belt
local multiplier = 1

local function stop(p, move)
	local s = sessions[p]
	if not s then return end
	sessions[p] = nil
	cooldown[p] = os.clock() + REENTER_COOLDOWN
	if s.track then s.track:Stop(0.15) s.track:Destroy() end
	if s.root and s.root.Parent then
		s.root.Anchored = s.anchored
		if move and s.hum.Health > 0 then s.root.CFrame = s.lane.exit end
	end
	if s.hum and s.hum.Parent then s.hum.AutoRotate = s.auto end
	if s.lane then s.lane.occupant = nil end
	p:SetAttribute("AdminTreadmillRunning", false)
end

local function start(p, lane, root, hum)
	if sessions[p] or lane.occupant then return end
	if not (_G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(p)) then return end
	local stand = lane.stand * CFrame.new(0, hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2, 0)
	sessions[p] = { root = root, hum = hum, anchored = root.Anchored, auto = hum.AutoRotate, lane = lane, owed = 0 }
	lane.occupant = p
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.CFrame = stand
	root.Anchored = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	p:SetAttribute("AdminTreadmillRunning", true)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if animator then
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.AnimationId = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "rbxassetid://180426354" or "rbxassetid://913376220"
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
		anim:Destroy()
		if ok then
			sessions[p].track = track
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track.Looped = true
			track:Play(0.15, 1, rateFor(p))
		end
	end
end

local function disable()
	for p in pairs(sessions) do stop(p, true) end
	if activeModel then activeModel:Destroy() end
	activeModel, belt = nil, nil
	table.clear(lanes)
end

local function enable()
	activeModel = template:Clone()
	activeModel.Name = "AdminTreadmill"
	activeModel.Parent = world
	belt = activeModel:WaitForChild("Belt")
	local slots = activeModel:WaitForChild("Slots")
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local marker = slots:WaitForChild("Slot" .. i)
		local exitPos = (belt.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, belt.Size.Z / 2 + 7.5)).Position
		lanes[i] = {index = i, stand = marker.CFrame, exit = CFrame.lookAt(exitPos, exitPos - belt.CFrame.LookVector)}
	end
end

local function laneFor(_localX)
	for _, lane in ipairs(lanes) do
		if not lane.occupant then return lane end
	end
end

local function tryEnter()
	local half = belt.Size / 2
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if not sessions[p] and (cooldown[p] or 0) < now then
			local char = p.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not root.Anchored and not hum.Sit then
				local rel = belt.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
				if math.abs(rel.X) < half.X and math.abs(rel.Z) < half.Z and rel.Y > 0 and rel.Y < STAND_HEIGHT then
					local lane = laneFor(rel.X)
					if lane then start(p, lane, root, hum) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clock(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec))
	if sec >= 3600 then
		return ("%d:%02d:%02d"):format(sec // 3600, sec % 3600 // 60, sec % 60)
	end
	return ("%d:%02d"):format(sec // 60, sec % 60)
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p) stop(p, true) end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	stop(p, false)
	cooldown[p] = nil
end)
local function bind(p) p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() stop(p, false) end) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do bind(p) end

local elapsed = 0
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 0.1 then return end
	local step = math.min(elapsed, 0.25)
	elapsed = 0

	local boost = _G.GlobalBoost
	multiplier = boost and boost.value("treadmill") or 1
	if multiplier <= 1 then
		if activeModel then disable() end
		return
	end
	if not activeModel then enable() end

	local state = boost.state().treadmill
	local endsAt = state and state.endsAt or 0
	activeModel:SetAttribute("Multiplier", multiplier)
	activeModel:SetAttribute("EndsAt", endsAt)
	local holo = activeModel:FindFirstChild("Hologram", true)
	if holo then
		local mult = holo:FindFirstChild("Mult")
		local info = holo:FindFirstChild("Info")
		if mult then mult.Text = ("x%g SPEED"):format(multiplier) end
		if info then
			local left = endsAt > 0 and ("  •  " .. clock(endsAt - os.time())) or ""
			info.Text = ("YOUR TREADMILL x%g%s"):format(multiplier, left)
		end
	end

	tryEnter()

	local beltRate = 1
	for p, s in pairs(sessions) do
		local rate = rateFor(p)
		beltRate = math.max(beltRate, rate)
		if s.track and s.track.IsPlaying then s.track:AdjustSpeed(rate) end
	end
	activeModel:SetAttribute("BeltRate", beltRate)

	for p, s in pairs(sessions) do
		if not s.root.Parent or s.hum.Health <= 0 or (s.root.Position - s.lane.stand.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
			stop(p, false)
		else
			s.owed += step
			local every = U.MILL.awardEvery or 0.5
			if s.owed >= every then
				s.owed -= every
				local plot = _G.Plots and _G.Plots.of(p)
				local level = plot and plot.mill:GetAttribute("MillLevel") or 1
				local award = U.MILL.awardBase * U.MILL.awardGrowth ^ (math.clamp(level, 1, U.MAX_LEVEL) - 1)
				award *= (p:GetAttribute("TrailMult") or 1) * (_G.SpeedMult and _G.SpeedMult(p) or 1)
					* boost.value("speed") * multiplier * (_G.RebirthMult and _G.RebirthMult(p) or 1)
				local speed = p:GetAttribute("Speed") or Cfg.SPEED_START
				if award == award and award < math.huge then p:SetAttribute("Speed", math.min(speed + award, Cfg.SPEED_MAX)) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

function M.tierOf(species)
	return species and RARITY[species] or nil

function M.template(species)

local function speciesOf(zone)
	local names, seen = {}, {}
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	local set = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. tostring(zone))
	if set then
		for _, m in ipairs(set:GetChildren()) do
			if not seen[m.Name] then seen[m.Name] = true table.insert(names, m.Name) end
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if t:GetAttribute("Zone") == zone and not seen[t.Name] then
			seen[t.Name] = true
			table.insert(names, t.Name)
		end
	end
	return names
end
M.speciesOf = speciesOf

function M.pick(zone, tier)
	local all = speciesOf(zone)
	local list = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(all) do
		if RARITY[name] == tier then table.insert(list, name) end
	end
	if #list == 0 then list = all end
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	return list[rng:NextInteger(1, #list)]
end

function M.legacy(zone, tier, size)
	local lib = workspace:FindFirstChild("AnimalLibrary")
	local set = lib and lib:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. tostring(zone))
	if not set then return nil end
	local list = set:GetChildren()
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	if #list == 0 then return nil end
	local slot = (tier or 1) >= 3 and 6 + ((tier or 3) - 2) or math.clamp(size or 1, 1, 6)
	return list[((slot - 1) % #list) + 1].Name
end

return M

local seen = {}

local function take(into, id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" then return end
	if id:match("^rbxasset://") then return end
	if seen[id] then return end
	seen[id] = true
	into[#into + 1] = id
end

local YIELD_EVERY = 4000
local scanned = 0

local function sweep(root, into)
	if not root then return end
	for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if not SKIP[d] then
			if d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
				take(into, d.Image)
			elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
				take(into, d.Texture)
			elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") then
				take(into, d.MeshId)
				take(into, d.TextureID)
			elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				take(into, d.MeshId)
				take(into, d.TextureId)
			elseif d:IsA("Sound") then
				take(into, d.SoundId)
			elseif d:IsA("Animation") then
				take(into, d.AnimationId)
			end
		end
		scanned = scanned + 1
		if scanned % YIELD_EVERY == 0 then task.wait() end
	end
end

function M.unlocked(profile,zone)
 if zone==0 then return true end
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=math.floor(zone) or not Config[zone] then return false end
 if tonumber(profile.BatForced)==zone then return true end
 local found={}
 for _,key in ipairs(profile.PetIndex or {}) do found[key]=true end
 for slot=1,8 do if not found[zone.."_"..slot] then return false end end
 return true
end
local function profile(p) return _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(p) end
function M.equipped(p)

 local zone=prof and tonumber(prof.BatEquipped) or 0
 if not prof or not M.unlocked(prof,zone) then return 0 end
 return zone
end
local function visibility(tool)
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do
  if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and v.Name=="IndexBatParticles" then v.Enabled=tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")~=nil end
 end
end
function M.apply(p,tool)
 if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Name~="Stick" then return end
 local zone=M.equipped(p)
 if tool:GetAttribute("BatZone")==zone then visibility(tool) return end
 local cfg=Config[zone]
 for _,v in tool:GetDescendants() do if v.Name=="IndexBatFX" then v:Destroy() end end
 for _,part in tool:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
   if part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture")==nil then
    part:SetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture",part.TextureID)
    part:SetAttribute("BatOriginalColor",part.Color)
   end
   part.TextureID=cfg and cfg.Texture or part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalTexture")
   part.Color=cfg and cfg.Color or part:GetAttribute("BatOriginalColor")
  end
 end
 local barrel=tool:FindFirstChild("barrel_geom") or tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if cfg and barrel then
  for i=-1,1 do
   local fx=Instance.new("Attachment") fx.Name="IndexBatFX"
   fx.Position=Vector3.new(i==0 and -.4 or .4,i*barrel.Size.Y*.32,0)
   fx.Parent=barrel
   local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter") e.Name="IndexBatParticles" e.Texture=cfg.Particle
   e.Rate=12 e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,1.3) e.Speed=NumberRange.new(.7,1.2)
   e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180) e.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360) e.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-65,65)
   e.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.25,.7),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.12)})
   e.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.08),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.65,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
   e.Color=ColorSequence.new(cfg.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.3))
   e.LightEmission=.8 e.LightInfluence=0 e.LockedToPart=true e.ZOffset=.15 e.Parent=fx
  end
 end
 tool:SetAttribute("BatZone",zone)
 tool.ToolTip=cfg and cfg.Name or "Golden Bat"
 tool.TextureId=cfg and cfg.Icon or "rbxassetid://128088129405176"
 visibility(tool)
 if not tool:GetAttribute("BatWatched") then
  tool:SetAttribute("BatWatched",true)
  tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() visibility(tool) end)
 end
end
function M.refresh(p)
 p:SetAttribute("BatEquipped",M.equipped(p))
 for _,root in {p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"),p.Character} do
  if root then for _,t in root:GetChildren() do M.apply(p,t) end end
 end
end
function M.equip(p,zone)
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=zone or zone~=math.floor(zone) then return false end
 local prof=profile(p)
 if not prof or not M.unlocked(prof,zone) then return false end
 prof.BatEquipped=zone M.refresh(p) return true
end
function M.adminSet(p,zone)
 if type(zone)~="number" or zone~=zone or zone~=math.floor(zone) then return false end
 if zone~=0 and not Config[zone] then return false end
 local prof=profile(p)
 if not prof then return false end
 prof.BatForced=zone~=0 and zone or nil
 prof.BatEquipped=zone
 M.refresh(p)
 return true
end
function M.knockback(p)
 local cfg=Config[M.equipped(p)]
 local n=cfg and tonumber(cfg.KnockbackMultiplier) or 1
 if not n or n~=n or n==math.huge then return 1 end
 return math.clamp(n,0,10)
end
function M.init()
 if initialized then return end initialized=true
 local watched=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local function bind(p)
  local function watch(root)
   if not root or watched[root] then return end
   watched[root]=true
   root.ChildAdded:Connect(function(t) task.defer(M.apply,p,t) end)
   for _,t in root:GetChildren() do M.apply(p,t) end
  end
  p.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) if c:IsA("Backpack") then watch(c) end end)
  p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
   watch(ch)
   watch(p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
  end)
  task.spawn(function()
   local bag=p:WaitForChild("Backpack",30)
   if bag then watch(bag) end
   if p.Character then watch(p.Character) end
   for i=1,120 do if not p.Parent then return end if profile(p) then M.refresh(p) return end task.wait(.5) end
  end)
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bind)
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do bind(p) end
end
return M

local function floorAt(pos)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignore = {}
	if egg then table.insert(ignore, egg) end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then table.insert(ignore, p.Character) end end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 8, pos.Z), Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), params)
	return hit and hit.Position.Y or 0.5
end

local function buildEgg()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "CaptureEgg"
	core = Instance.new("Part")
	core.Name = "Core"
	core.Size = Vector3.new(5.2, 6.8, 5.2)
	core.Transparency = 1
	core.Anchored = true
	core.CanCollide = false
	core.CanTouch = true
	core.CanQuery = false
	core.Massless = true
	core.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = core
	local BEIGE = Color3.fromRGB(204, 182, 140)
	local SHADE = Color3.fromRGB(172, 146, 104)
	local SPOT = Color3.fromRGB(106, 66, 38)
	local widths = { 2.4, 3.6, 4.4, 4.8, 4.8, 4.4, 3.8, 3.0, 1.8 }
	local h = 0.72
	local y0 = -3.2
	local function block(size, offset, colour)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = "Voxel"
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		p.Color = colour
		p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.Anchored = false
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.Massless = true
		p.Parent = model
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Part0 = core
		w.Part1 = p
		w.Parent = p
		return p
	end
	for i, w in ipairs(widths) do
		local y = y0 + (i - 0.5) * h

local function rescale(k)

	local parts = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(egg:GetDescendants()) do

		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
			table.insert(parts, d)
		end

	egg:ScaleTo(k)
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p ~= core then
			p.Anchored = false

local function drop(returnHome)
	local p = state.holder
	state.holder = nil
	if p then
		cooldown[p] = os.clock() + Cfg.PickupCooldown
		release(p)
	end
	local root = p and rootOf(p)
	local pos = (not returnHome and root and inArena(root.Position)) and root.Position or Cfg.Center
	placeIdle(pos)
end

function grab(p)
	if not state.active or state.holder or not core then return end
	if (cooldown[p] or 0) > os.clock() then return end
	if p:GetAttribute("Stunned") or p:GetAttribute("CarryingEgg") then return end
	local root, hum = rootOf(p)
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not inArena(root.Position) then return end
	local ch = p.Character
	local anchor = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
	state.holder = p
	names[p.UserId] = p.DisplayName
	scores[p.UserId] = scores[p.UserId] or 0
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() prompt = nil end
	hum:UnequipTools()
	core.Anchored = true
	rescale((Cfg.EggScale or 1) * (Cfg.HeldScale or 0.5))
	core.CFrame = anchor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -(anchor.Size.Z / 2 + core.Size.Z / 2 + 0.3))
	core.Anchored = false
	weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = anchor
	weld.Part1 = core
	weld.Parent = core
	p:SetAttribute("HoldingCaptureEgg", true)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryingEgg", true)
	p:SetAttribute("CarryCenter", anchor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(core.Position))
	p:SetAttribute("CarrySize", core.Size)
	if holderLabel then holderLabel.Text = "HELD BY " .. string.upper(p.DisplayName) end
end

local function ranking()
	local list = {}
	for userId, secs in pairs(scores) do
		table.insert(list, { u = userId, n = names[userId] or "?", s = math.floor(secs * 10) / 10 })
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.s > b.s end)
	return list
end

local function publishState()
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggActive", state.active)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggEndsAt", state.endsAt)
	workspace:SetAttribute("CaptureEggMult", state.mult)
	remote:FireAllClients("state", {
		active = state.active, endsAt = state.endsAt, mult = state.mult,
		holder = state.holder and state.holder.UserId or 0, list = ranking(),
	})
end

local function finish()
	if not state.active then return end
	if state.holder then drop(true) end
	local list = ranking()
	local winners = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local e = list[i]
		local reward = Cfg.Rewards[i]
		if e and reward and e.s >= 1 then
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(e.u)
			local speed = math.floor((reward.Speed or 0) * state.mult)
			local money = math.floor((reward.Money or 0) * state.mult)
			if p then
				if speed > 0 then
					p:SetAttribute("Speed", math.clamp((tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Speed")) or 0) + speed, 0, EggCfg.SPEED_MAX))
				end
				if money > 0 and _G.Profile then
					_G.Profile.set(p, "Coins", _G.Profile.value(p, "wallet", "Coins") + money)
				end
			end
			table.insert(winners, { u = e.u, n = e.n, s = e.s, speed = speed, money = money, place = i })
		end
	end
	state.active = false
	state.endsAt = 0
	if egg then egg:Destroy() end
	egg, core, weld, hologram, prompt = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p:GetAttribute("HoldingCaptureEgg") then release(p) end
	end
	publishState()
	remote:FireAllClients("results", { winners = winners })
end

local function startLocal(endsAt, mult)
	state.mult = math.clamp(tonumber(mult) or 1, 1, 1000)
	state.endsAt = endsAt
	if not state.active then

		scores, names, cooldown = {}, {}, {}
		state.holder = nil
		if egg then egg:Destroy() end
		egg = buildEgg()
		placeIdle(Cfg.Center)
	end
	publishState()
end

local function stopLocal()
	if not state.active then return end
	state.endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	finish()
end

local function applyLook(look, seconds)
    local now = clockValue.Value % 24
    clockValue.Value = now

    local goal = now + (look.clock - now) % 24
    if seconds <= 0 then
        clockValue.Value = goal
        Lighting.Brightness = look.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = look.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = look.OutdoorAmbient
        if atmosphere and look.atmoColor then
            atmosphere.Color = look.atmoColor
            atmosphere.Decay = look.atmoDecay
        end
        return
    end
    local info = TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(clockValue, info, { Value = goal }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Lighting, info, {
        Brightness = look.Brightness,
        Ambient = look.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient = look.OutdoorAmbient,
    }):Play()

    if atmosphere and look.atmoColor then
        TweenService:Create(atmosphere, info, { Color = look.atmoColor, Decay = look.atmoDecay }):Play()
    end
end

local function findGap()
    local walls = map:FindFirstChild("Walls")
    local spawnPart = map:FindFirstChild("MainSpawn")
    local midX = spawnPart and spawnPart.Position.X or 1500
    local left, right
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and w.Name == "WallSegment" and w.Size.X > w.Size.Z
            and math.abs(w.Position.Z - EggCfg.SAFE_Z) < 15 then
            if w.Position.X < midX then left = w else right = w end
        end
    end
    if not (left and right) then
        warn("[DAYNIGHT] no gap in the wall found - the map will not close at night")
        return nil
    end
    return {
        x0 = left.Position.X + left.Size.X / 2,
        x1 = right.Position.X - right.Size.X / 2,
        z = left.Position.Z,
        y0 = left.Position.Y - left.Size.Y / 2,
        y1 = left.Position.Y + left.Size.Y / 2,
        thick = left.Size.Z,
    }
end

local function buildGate()
    local g = GAP
    local width, height = g.x1 - g.x0, g.y1 - g.y0
    local cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2

    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = "NightGate"
    model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local walls = map:FindFirstChild("Walls")
    local wallTop = g.y1
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and math.abs(w.Position.Z - g.z) < 10 then
            wallTop = math.max(wallTop, w.Position.Y + w.Size.Y / 2)
        end
    end
    local wallH = wallTop - g.y0

    local function white(part, face)
        local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        sg.Name = "White"
        sg.Face = face
        sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
        sg.PixelsPerStud = 1
        sg.LightInfluence = 0
        sg.Parent = part
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
        f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        f.Parent = sg
    end

    local wall = Instance.new("Part")
    wall.Name = "Gate"
    wall.Anchored = true
    wall.CastShadow = false
    wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    wall.Color = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
    wall.Size = Vector3.new(width, wallH, 2)
    wall.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, g.y0 + wallH / 2, GATE_Z)
    wall.Parent = model
    white(wall, Enum.NormalId.Back)
    white(wall, Enum.NormalId.Top)

    local _, roofEnd = EggCfg.bounds(Cycle.ROOF_ZONES)
    local x0, x1 = math.huge, -math.huge
    for _, w in ipairs(walls and walls:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if w:IsA("BasePart") and w.Position.Z < g.z - 2 and w.Position.Z > roofEnd then
            x0 = math.min(x0, w.Position.X - w.Size.X / 2)
            x1 = math.max(x1, w.Position.X + w.Size.X / 2)
        end
    end
    if x0 > x1 then x0, x1 = g.x0 - g.thick, g.x1 + g.thick end
    local roofLen = (GATE_Z + 1) - roofEnd
    local roof = Instance.new("Part")
    roof.Name = "Roof"
    roof.Anchored = true
    roof.CastShadow = false
    roof.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    roof.Color = Cycle.GATE_COLOR
    roof.Size = Vector3.new(x1 - x0, 2, roofLen)
    roof.CFrame = CFrame.new((x0 + x1) / 2, wallTop + 1, (GATE_Z + 1) - roofLen / 2)
    roof.Parent = model
    white(roof, Enum.NormalId.Top)
    white(roof, Enum.NormalId.Back)

    local top = Instance.new("Part")
    top.Name = "GateBarrier"
    top.Anchored = true
    top.CastShadow = false
    top.Transparency = 1
    top.Size = Vector3.new(width, 400, 2)
    top.CFrame = CFrame.new(cx, wallTop + 200, GATE_Z)
    top.Parent = model

    return model
end

        elseif d:IsA("Frame") then

end

    local tier = forceTier or Cfg.rollTier(nil, _G.GlobalBoost and _G.GlobalBoost.value("eggluck") or 1)

        sizeDef, sizeIdx = Cfg.SIZES[forceSize], forceSize
    else
        sizeDef, sizeIdx = pickSizeUpTo(anchor:GetAttribute("MaxSize"))
    end
    local tierDef = Cfg.TIERS[tier]

    local species = AnimalEggs.pick(zone, tier)
    local speciesTpl = AnimalEggs.template(species)
    local model = (speciesTpl or eggTemplate(zone)):Clone()
    model.Name = string.format("Egg_Z%d_%d", zone, anchor:GetAttribute("Slot"))
    model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * sizeDef.scale)

    local c = Cfg.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local accent = Color3.new(c.R * 0.68, c.G * 0.68, c.B * 0.68)
    local glow = Cfg.GLOW[tier] or Cfg.GLOW[1]
    local shellPart
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local isShell = p.Name:lower():match("^shell") ~= nil
            if isShell then shellPart = shellPart or p end
            if not speciesTpl then
                if isShell then
                    p.Color = c
                    p.Material = glow.shell and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                else
                    p.Color = accent

                    if glow.deco then
                        p.Color = c
                        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    else
                        p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    end
                end
            end
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CastShadow = false
        end
    end

    if shellPart and glow.light > 0 and not speciesTpl then
        local lamp = Instance.new("PointLight")
        lamp.Name = "TierGlow"
        lamp.Color = c
        lamp.Brightness = glow.light
        lamp.Range = glow.range * math.clamp(sizeDef.scale, 0.6, 2.2)
        lamp.Shadows = false
        lamp.Parent = shellPart
    end
    model:SetAttribute("Zone", zone)
    model:SetAttribute("Tier", tier)
    model:SetAttribute("SizeIdx", sizeIdx)
    if species then model:SetAttribute("Species", species) end

    eggs[model] = {
        anchor = anchor, zone = zone, tier = tier, size = sizeIdx, species = species,
        value = Cfg.eggValue(zone, tier, sizeIdx), state = "anchor",
        bob = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi*2), floatY = FLOAT_Y,
        yaw = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2),
        half = 0,
    }
    model.Parent = anchor
    fitNest(anchor, sizeDef.scale)
    standAt(model, anchor.Position.X, FLOAT_Y, anchor.Position.Z, eggs[model].yaw)
    do
        local mnx, mxx, lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
        local mnz, mxz = math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local c, sz = d.CFrame, d.Size
                local ex = math.abs(c.RightVector.X)*sz.X/2 + math.abs(c.UpVector.X)*sz.Y/2 + math.abs(c.LookVector.X)*sz.Z/2
                local ey = math.abs(c.RightVector.Y)*sz.X/2 + math.abs(c.UpVector.Y)*sz.Y/2 + math.abs(c.LookVector.Y)*sz.Z/2
                local ez = math.abs(c.RightVector.Z)*sz.X/2 + math.abs(c.UpVector.Z)*sz.Y/2 + math.abs(c.LookVector.Z)*sz.Z/2
                mnx = math.min(mnx, c.Position.X - ex); mxx = math.max(mxx, c.Position.X + ex)
                lo  = math.min(lo,  c.Position.Y - ey); hi  = math.max(hi,  c.Position.Y + ey)
                mnz = math.min(mnz, c.Position.Z - ez); mxz = math.max(mxz, c.Position.Z + ez)
            end
        end
        eggs[model].half = (mxx - mnx) / 2
        eggs[model].halfH = (hi - lo) / 2
        eggs[model].halfD = (mxz - mnz) / 2
    end
    attachPrompt(model)
    return model
end

local CARRY_MIN_SCALE = 0.3
local CARRY_GRIP_GAP = 0.05

local function isArmJoint(j)
    return j ~= nil and (j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint"))
end

local function jointFrames(j)
    if j:IsA("Motor6D") then return j.C0, j.C1 end
    local a0, a1 = j.Attachment0, j.Attachment1
    return a0 and a0.CFrame or CFrame.identity, a1 and a1.CFrame or CFrame.identity
end

local function hugLayout(ch, torso, model)
    local upper = ch:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm")
    local lower = ch:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm")
    local hand = ch:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
    local sh = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
    local el = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("RightElbow")
    local wr = hand and hand:FindFirstChild("RightWrist")
    if not (isArmJoint(sh) and isArmJoint(el) and isArmJoint(wr)) then
        return nil
    end
    local s0, s1 = jointFrames(sh)
    local e0, e1 = jointFrames(el)
    local w0, w1 = jointFrames(wr)
    local S = s0.Position
    S = Vector3.new(math.abs(S.X), S.Y, S.Z)
    local reach = ((e0.Position - s1.Position).Magnitude
        + (w0.Position - e1.Position).Magnitude
        + w1.Position.Magnitude) * 0.95
    local boxCF, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
    local pivotToCenter = model:GetPivot():PointToObjectSpace(boxCF.Position)
    local half0 = size / 2
    local tz = torso.Size.Z / 2
    local handHalf = hand.Size.X / 2

    local best
    for step = 0, 14 do
        local scale = math.max(CARRY_MIN_SCALE, 1 - step * 0.05)
        local half = half0 * scale
        local yc = S.Y - 0.35 - half.Y * 0.2
        for _, sink in ipairs({ 0, 0.5, 1 }) do
            local zc = -(tz + half.Z + 0.05) + sink * (tz * 0.4 + half.Z * 0.3)
            local grip = Vector3.new(half.X * 0.94 + CARRY_GRIP_GAP + handHalf, yc - half.Y * 0.15, zc + half.Z * 0.35)
            local d = (grip - S).Magnitude
            if not best or d - reach < best.miss then
                best = { scale = scale, center = Vector3.new(0, yc, zc), pivotToCenter = pivotToCenter, miss = d - reach }
            end
            if d <= reach then return best end
        end
        if scale <= CARRY_MIN_SCALE then break end
    end
    return best
end

function attachToHands(model, plr, e)
    local ch = plr.Character
    local root = rootOf(plr)
    if not root or not ch then return false end
    local shell = model.PrimaryPart
    if not shell then return false end

    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then d:Destroy() end
    end
    local base = model:GetAttribute("CarryBaseScale") or model:GetScale()
    if math.abs(model:GetScale() - base) > 1e-4 then model:ScaleTo(base) end

    local anchorPart = ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
    local layout = (anchorPart.Name == "UpperTorso") and hugLayout(ch, anchorPart, model) or nil
    if layout then
        model:SetAttribute("CarryBaseScale", base)
        if layout.scale < 0.999 then model:ScaleTo(base * layout.scale) end
        model:PivotTo(anchorPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(layout.center - layout.pivotToCenter * layout.scale))
        local placedCF = model:GetBoundingBox()
        local drift = layout.center - anchorPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(placedCF.Position)
        model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + anchorPart.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(drift))
    else
        local halfH = e.halfH or 1.6
        local half  = e.half  or 1.3
        local holdY = math.max(0.6, (0.3 + halfH) - anchorPart.Position.Y)
        local halfD = e.halfD or half
        local holdZ = -(anchorPart.Size.Z / 2 + halfD + 0.35)
        model:PivotTo(anchorPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, holdY, holdZ))

        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local groundY = root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y / 2 - (hum and hum.HipHeight or 2)
        local lowest = math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local cf, sz = p.CFrame, p.Size
                local ext = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)  * sz.X / 2
                          + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)     * sz.Y / 2
                          + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)   * sz.Z / 2
                lowest = math.min(lowest, cf.Position.Y - ext)
            end
        end
        local lift = (groundY + 0.45) - lowest
        if lift > 0 then
            model:PivotTo(anchorPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, holdY + lift, holdZ))
        end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = false
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.Massless = true
            if p ~= shell then
                local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                w.Name = "EggWeld"; w.Part0 = shell; w.Part1 = p; w.Parent = shell
            end
        end
    end
    local hw = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    hw.Name = "HandWeld"; hw.Part0 = anchorPart; hw.Part1 = shell; hw.Parent = shell
    local boxCF, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
    plr:SetAttribute("CarryCenter", anchorPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(boxCF.Position))
    plr:SetAttribute("CarrySize", boxSize)
    return true
end
function detachFromHands(model, plr)
    if plr then setArmsCarrying(plr, false) end
    for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then d:Destroy() end
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = true
            p.Massless = false
        end
    end
    local base = model:GetAttribute("CarryBaseScale")

end

local function modelBox(m)

        if d:IsA("BasePart") then

                math.abs(cf.RightVector.X)*sz.X/2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X)*sz.Y/2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X)*sz.Z/2,
                math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*sz.X/2 + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*sz.Y/2 + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*sz.Z/2,

local function pickTarget(b)
    local best, bestVal = nil, -1
    for plr, model in pairs(carriers) do
        local e = eggs[model]
        local root, hum = rootOf(plr)
        if e and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not inSafeZone(root.Position.Z) then
            local pz = root.Position.Z
            local mineEgg = (e.zone == b.zoneIndex)
            local inMine  = (pz <= b.zTop and pz >= b.zBot)
            local chase = mineEgg or (Cfg.FOREIGN_BOSS_CHASES and inMine)
            if chase and e.value > bestVal then best, bestVal = plr, e.value end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function findLoose(b)
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    for model, e in pairs(eggs) do
        if e.state == "loose" and e.zone == b.zoneIndex then
            local p = model:GetPivot().Position
            if p.Z <= b.zTop and p.Z >= b.zBot then
                local d = (p - b.cf.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestD then best, bestD = model, d end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function setBossCF(b, cf)
    b.cf = cf
end

local function moveBoss(b, goal, speed, dt, faceGoal)
    local pos = b.cf.Position
    local dir = goal - pos
    local dist = dir.Magnitude
    if dist < 0.05 then return 0 end
    local step = dir.Unit * math.min(speed * dt, dist)
    local np   = pos + step
    local look = faceGoal and Vector3.new(goal.X, np.Y, goal.Z) or (np + dir)

    if (look - np).Magnitude > 0.05 then
        setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(np, look))
    else
        local cf = b.cf
        setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(np) * (cf - cf.Position))
    end
    return dist
end

    b.model:SetAttribute("Angry", false)

local function wakeUp(b)

local function bossStrike(n, b, target, root, hum, model, e)
    local away = (root.Position - b.cf.Position)
    away = (away.Magnitude > 0.1) and away.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)

    local hit = Cfg.hitFor(speedOf(target), e.zone, e.size)

    Remote:FireClient(target, "BossHit", { zone = e.zone, stun = hit.stun })
    local push = away * hit.back + Vector3.new(0, hit.up, 0)

    pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)

    if hum then Ragdoll.on(hum.Parent) end
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = push

    local spin = away:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
    spin = (spin.Magnitude > 0.01) and spin.Unit * 7 or Vector3.new(7, 0, 0)
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = spin

    task.delay(0.06, function()
        if root.Parent then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = push
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = spin
        end
    end)

    task.delay(hit.stun, function()
        if hum and hum.Parent then Ragdoll.off(hum.Parent) end
        pcall(function()
            if root.Parent and target.Parent then
                root:SetNetworkOwner(target)
            end
        end)
    end)

    local pz = root.Position.Z
    local inMyZone = (pz <= b.zTop and pz >= b.zBot)
    local takeBack = (e.zone == n) and inMyZone
    makeLoose(model, root.Position)

    if takeBack then
        detachPrompt(model)
        e.state = "boss"
        b.hold = model
        game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(model, "BossHeldEgg")
        model:SetAttribute("HeldBy", n)
        model:SetAttribute("HeldYaw", e.yaw or 0)
        b.afterAttack = "carryback"
    else
        b.afterAttack = "returning"
    end
    Remote:FireClient(target, "Caught", {
        boss = Cfg.NAMES[n],
        kept = takeBack,
    })
end

local function stepBossCore(n, b, dt)
    local pos = b.cf.Position

    if pos.X ~= pos.X or pos.Y ~= pos.Y or pos.Z ~= pos.Z
       or math.abs(pos.Y) > 5000 then
        warn(("[EggBoss] boss %d had an invalid position - returned to its lair"):format(n))
        setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(b.homeXZ.X, b.awakeY, b.homeXZ.Y))
        b.state = "returning"
        if b.hold then releaseHeld(b.hold) end
        b.hold = nil
        pos = b.cf.Position
    end

    if b.state == "carryback" and b.hold and eggs[b.hold] then
        local e = eggs[b.hold]
        local goal = Vector3.new(e.anchor.Position.X, b.awakeY, e.anchor.Position.Z)
        local d = moveBoss(b, goal, Cfg.BOSS.carryBackSpd, dt, true)

        if d < b.H * 0.7 + 4 then
            placeAtAnchor(b.hold)
            b.hold = nil
            b.state = "returning"
        end
        return
    elseif b.state == "carryback" then
        b.hold = nil; b.state = "returning"
    end

    if b.state == "waking" then
        b.wakeT = b.wakeT + dt
        local k = math.clamp(b.wakeT / WAKE_TIME, 0, 1)
        local y = b.sleepY + (b.awakeY - b.sleepY) * (k * k * (3 - 2 * k))

        local wt = pickTarget(b)
        local wroot = wt and rootOf(wt)
        local dx, dz = 0, 0
        if wroot and k > 0.25 then
            local d = Vector3.new(wroot.Position.X - pos.X, 0, wroot.Position.Z - pos.Z)
            local m = d.Magnitude
            if m > 0.001 then
                local wcar = carriers[wt]
                local we = wcar and eggs[wcar]
                local pace = we
                    and Cfg.bossSpeedFor(speedOf(wt), we.zone, we.size)
                    or Cfg.walkForSpeed(speedOf(wt)) * 0.9
                local step = math.min(pace * ((k - 0.25) / 0.75) * dt, m)
                dx, dz = d.X / m * step, d.Z / m * step
            end
        end

        if wroot and k > 0.25 then
            local np   = Vector3.new(pos.X + dx, y, pos.Z + dz)
            local look = Vector3.new(wroot.Position.X, y, wroot.Position.Z)

            if (look - np).Magnitude > 0.05 then
                setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(np, look))
            else
                local cf = b.cf
                setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(np) * (cf - cf.Position))
            end
        else
            setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(pos.X, y, pos.Z)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, homeYaw(b), 0))
        end
        if k >= 1 then b.state = "chase" end
        return
    end

    if b.state == "attack" then
        b.atkT = b.atkT + dt
        if not b.struck then
            local target = b.atkTarget
            local root, hum
            if target and target.Parent then root, hum = rootOf(target) end
            local model = target and carriers[target]
            local e = model and eggs[model]
            if not (root and e) or inSafeZone(root.Position.Z) then
                b.state, b.atkTarget = "chase", nil
                return
            end
            local goal = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, b.awakeY, root.Position.Z)
            local reach = Cfg.BOSS.catchRadius + b.H * 0.35
            local dist = (goal - pos).Magnitude
            if dist > reach * 0.8 then
                moveBoss(b, goal, Cfg.bossSpeedFor(speedOf(target), e.zone, e.size), dt, true)
            end
            if b.atkT >= strikeTime(b) then
                if dist <= reach * 1.3 + 2 then
                    b.struck = true
                    bossStrike(n, b, target, root, hum, model, e)
                else
                    b.state, b.atkTarget = "chase", nil
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if b.atkT >= ATTACK_TIME then
            b.state = b.afterAttack or "returning"
            b.afterAttack, b.atkTarget = nil, nil
        end
        return
    end

    local target = pickTarget(b)

    if target and b.state == "sleep" then
        wakeUp(b)
        return
    end

    if target then
        b.state = "chase"
        local root, hum = rootOf(target)
        if root then
            local goal = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, b.awakeY, root.Position.Z)
            local dist = (goal - pos).Magnitude
            local reach = Cfg.BOSS.catchRadius + b.H * 0.35
            local toward = Vector3.new(goal.X - pos.X, 0, goal.Z - pos.Z)
            local runAway = toward.Magnitude > 0.1
                and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(toward.Unit) or 0
            local cc = carriers[target]
            local ee = cc and eggs[cc]
            local bossPace = ee and Cfg.bossSpeedFor(speedOf(target), ee.zone, ee.size) or 0
            local lead = math.clamp((bossPace - runAway) * strikeTime(b), 0, reach)
            if dist <= reach + lead then
                if ee then
                    b.state = "attack"
                    b.atkT = 0
                    b.struck = false
                    b.atkTarget = target
                end
                return
            end

            local carried = carriers[target]
            local ce = carried and eggs[carried]
            local pace = ce
                and Cfg.bossSpeedFor(speedOf(target), ce.zone, ce.size)
                or Cfg.walkForSpeed(speedOf(target)) * 0.9
            local sp = (dist > Cfg.BOSS.closeRange)
                and (pace * Cfg.BOSS.closeSpeed) or pace
            moveBoss(b, goal, sp, dt, true)
            return
        end
    end

    if b.state ~= "sleep" then
        local loose = findLoose(b)
        if loose then
            b.state = "fetch"
            local goal = loose:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, b.awakeY, 0)
            local d = moveBoss(b, goal, Cfg.BOSS.fetchSpeed, dt, true)
            if d <= Cfg.BOSS.grabRadius + b.H * 0.5 then
                detachPrompt(loose)
                eggs[loose].state = "boss"
                b.hold = loose
                game:GetService("CollectionService"):AddTag(loose, "BossHeldEgg")
                loose:SetAttribute("HeldBy", n)
                loose:SetAttribute("HeldYaw", eggs[loose].yaw or 0)
                b.state = "carryback"
            end
            return
        end
    end

    local homeAwake = Vector3.new(b.homeXZ.X, b.awakeY, b.homeXZ.Y)
    local flat = (Vector3.new(pos.X, 0, pos.Z) - Vector3.new(b.homeXZ.X, 0, b.homeXZ.Y)).Magnitude
    if flat > 2.5 then
        b.state = "returning"
        local back = math.clamp(flat * 0.7, Cfg.BOSS.returnSpeed, 420)
        moveBoss(b, homeAwake, back, dt, false)
        return
    end

    if b.state ~= "sleep" then

        local y = pos.Y - (b.awakeY - b.sleepY) * dt * 1.6
        if y <= b.sleepY + 0.05 then
            y = b.sleepY
            sleepDown(b)
        end
        setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(b.homeXZ.X, y, b.homeXZ.Y)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, homeYaw(b), 0))
        return
    end

    b.phase = b.phase + dt
    setBossCF(b, CFrame.new(b.homeXZ.X,
        b.sleepY,
        b.homeXZ.Y) * CFrame.Angles(0, homeYaw(b) + math.sin(b.phase * 0.22) * 0.10, 0))
end

local SLEEP_STEP = 0.1
local PUBLISH_EVERY = 1 / 30

local function publishBoss(b, force)
    local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    if not force and b.lastPub and now - b.lastPub < PUBLISH_EVERY then return end
    local pos = b.cf.Position
    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local gap = b.lastPub and (now - b.lastPub) or 0
    if b.state ~= "sleep" and not (b.state == "attack" and b.struck) then
        if b.pubPos and gap > 0.01 then
            local raw = (pos - b.pubPos) / gap
            vel = (b.pubVel or raw):Lerp(raw, 0.5)
        else
            vel = b.pubVel or Vector3.zero
        end
    end
    b.pubVel = vel
    b.model:SetAttribute("BossCF", b.cf)
    b.model:SetAttribute("BossVel", vel)
    b.model:SetAttribute("BossStamp", now)
    b.pubPos, b.lastPub = pos, now
end

local function stepBoss(n, b, dt)
    if b.state == "sleep" and next(carriers) == nil and b.pubState == "sleep" then
        b.idleAcc = (b.idleAcc or 0) + dt
        if b.idleAcc < SLEEP_STEP then return end
        dt, b.idleAcc = b.idleAcc, 0
    end
    stepBossCore(n, b, dt)
    if b.pubState ~= b.state then
        b.pubState = b.state
        b.model:SetAttribute("BossState", b.state)
        b.model:SetAttribute("BossStateAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
        publishBoss(b, true)
    elseif b.state ~= "sleep" then
        publishBoss(b, false)
    end
end

local function stepEggs(dt)
    local t = os.clock()
    for model, e in pairs(eggs) do
        if not model.Parent then
            eggs[model] = nil
        elseif not model.PrimaryPart then
            local plr = e.carrier
            if plr and carriers[plr] == model then
                carriers[plr] = nil
                pcall(setCarrying, plr, false)
                setSpeed(plr, 1)
            end
            eggs[model] = nil
            model:Destroy()
        elseif e.state == "player" then
            local plr = e.carrier
            local root = plr and rootOf(plr)
            if not root then

                makeLoose(model, model:GetPivot().Position)
            else

                if model.PrimaryPart and not model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("HandWeld") then
                    attachToHands(model, plr, e)
                end
                if inSafeZone(root.Position.Z) then
                    local dist = Cfg.SAFE_Z - (e.pickPos and e.pickPos.Z or Cfg.SAFE_Z)
                    local reach = (Cfg.WALK_BASE + Cfg.WALK_RANGE) * 1.5 * (os.clock() - (e.pickT or 0)) + 60
                    if dist > reach and e.pickPos then
                        makeLoose(model, e.pickPos)

local function buildEggTool(zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local speciesTpl = AnimalEggs.template(species)
    local tpl = speciesTpl or eggTemplate(zone)
    if not tpl then return nil end

    local m = tpl:Clone()
    local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
    if box.Y > 0.001 then m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (TOOL_HEIGHT / box.Y)) end

    local colour = Cfg.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local accent = Color3.new(colour.R * 0.68, colour.G * 0.68, colour.B * 0.68)
    local glow = Cfg.GLOW[tier] or Cfg.GLOW[1]

    local parts, shell = {}, nil
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, p)
            if not shell and p.Name:lower():match("^shell") then shell = p end
        end
    end
    if not shell then m:Destroy() return nil end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")

    tool.Name = string.format("%s %s %s Egg",
        species or Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone" .. zone),
        Cfg.TIERS[tier].name, Cfg.SIZES[size].name)
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.CanBeDropped = false
    tool:SetAttribute("EggZone", zone)
    tool:SetAttribute("EggTier", tier)
    tool:SetAttribute("EggSize", size)
    if species then tool:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", species) end
    if luck then tool:SetAttribute("EggLuck", luck) end

    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        local isShell = (p == shell)
        if not speciesTpl then
            p.Color = isShell and colour or (glow.deco and colour or accent)
            p.Material = ((isShell and glow.shell) or (not isShell and glow.deco))
                and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
        p.Anchored = false
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.Massless = true
        p.CastShadow = false
    end

    shell.Name = "Handle"

    shell:SetAttribute("RestOffset", CFrame.new())
    shell.Parent = tool
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p ~= shell then
            p:SetAttribute("RestOffset", shell.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame))
            p.Parent = tool
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Name = "EggWeld"; w.Part0 = shell; w.Part1 = p; w.Parent = shell
        end
    end
    m:Destroy()
    return tool
end

    local spot = root.Position + flat * GEAR.trapAhead
    spot = Vector3.new(
        math.clamp(spot.X, Cfg.X_MIN + 4, Cfg.X_MAX - 4),
        0,
        spot.Z)

    standAt(m, spot.X, 0.05, spot.Z, math.atan2(flat.X, flat.Z))
    m.Parent = trapsFolder

    local rec = {
        model = m, owner = plr,
        pos = Vector3.new(spot.X, 0, spot.Z),
        armedAt = os.clock() + GEAR.trapArm,

        ownerSafeUntil = os.clock() + GEAR.trapOwnerGrace,
        diesAt = os.clock() + GEAR.trapLife,
    }
    table.insert(traps, rec)
    syncTrapCount(plr)
    Remote:FireClient(plr, "Gear", { kind = "Trap", ok = true })
end

local function stepTraps()
    local now = os.clock()
    for index = #traps, 1, -1 do
        local t = traps[index]
        if not t.model.Parent or now >= t.diesAt then
            t.model:Destroy()
            table.remove(traps, index)
            syncTrapCount(t.owner)
        elseif now >= t.armedAt then
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local root = rootOf(plr)
                local ownerSafe = (plr == t.owner) and (os.clock() < (t.ownerSafeUntil or 0))
                if root and not ownerSafe and not isStunned(plr)
                   and not inSafeZone(root.Position.Z) then
                    local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
                    if (flat - t.pos).Magnitude <= GEAR.trapRadius then
                        dropCarried(plr)
                        if _G.CaptureEgg then pcall(_G.CaptureEgg.onHit, plr) end
                        freeze(plr, GEAR.trapStun)
                        Remote:FireClient(plr, "Gear",
                            { kind = "Trapped", seconds = GEAR.trapStun })
                        t.model:Destroy()
                        table.remove(traps, index)
                        syncTrapCount(t.owner)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local TRAP_HELD_SIZE = 1.7

local function buildTrapTool()
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Bear Trap"
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.CanBeDropped = false
    tool:SetAttribute("Gear", "Trap")

    local tpl = gearTemplate("TrapHeld") or gearTemplate("Trap")
    if tpl then
        local m = tpl:Clone()
        local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local widest = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
        if widest > 0.01 then m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (TRAP_HELD_SIZE / widest)) end

        local parts, handle = {}, nil
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                table.insert(parts, d)
                if d.Name == "Handle" or d.Name == "Plate" then handle = handle or d end
            end
        end
        handle = handle or parts[1]
        if handle then
            handle.Name = "Handle"
            for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p.Anchored = false end
            handle.Parent = tool
            for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
                if p ~= handle then
                    p.Parent = tool
                    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    w.Name = "GearWeld"; w.Part0 = handle; w.Part1 = p; w.Parent = handle
                end
            end
        end
        m:Destroy()
    end

    if not tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local h = Instance.new("Part")
        h.Name = "Handle"
        h.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        h.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 1.7, 1.7)
        h.Color = Color3.fromRGB(84, 88, 94)
        h.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        h.Parent = tool
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = false
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.Massless = true
            p.CastShadow = false
        end
    end

    tool.Grip = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0)
    return tool
end

local function giveGear(plr)
    local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not bag then return end
    local have = {}
    for _, where in ipairs({ bag, plr.Character }) do
        for _, t in ipairs(where and where:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("Gear") then have[t:GetAttribute("Gear")] = true end
        end
    end
    if not have.Stick then
        local st = buildStick()
        st.Activated:Connect(function() swing(plr) end)
        st.Parent = bag
    end
    if not have.Trap then
        local tr = buildTrapTool()
        tr.Activated:Connect(function() placeTrap(plr) end)
        tr.Parent = bag
    end
    syncTrapCount(plr)
end

local function hookGear(plr)

    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            if not plr.Parent then return end
            giveGear(plr)
            task.wait(1)
        end
        while plr.Parent do
            giveGear(plr)
            task.wait(5)
        end
    end)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.delay(1.2, function() if plr.Parent then giveGear(plr) end end)
    end)
end

local function ownsTool(plr, tool)
    if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (bag ~= nil and tool.Parent == bag) or (plr.Character ~= nil and tool.Parent == plr.Character)
end

local function forgetPet(prof, tool)
    local key = tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
    local list = prof.PetInventory
    if type(list) ~= "table" or type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(plr, action, tools)
    if action ~= "fuse" or type(tools) ~= "table" then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if (last[plr] or 0) + 1 > now then return end
    last[plr] = now

    local P = _G.Profile
    local prof = P and P.get(plr)
    if not prof then return end

    local picked, seen = {}, {}
    for i = 1, Fuse.SLOTS do
        local t = tools[i]
        if not (ownsTool(plr, t) and t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")) or seen[t] then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Put 3 pets in the machine")
            return
        end
        seen[t] = true
        picked[i] = t
    end

    local first = picked[1]
    local zone = first:GetAttribute("AnimalZone")
    local tier = first:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1
    local species = first:GetAttribute("Species")
    local sizes = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(picked) do
        if t:GetAttribute("AnimalZone") ~= zone or (t:GetAttribute("AnimalTier") or 1) ~= tier
           or t:GetAttribute("Species") ~= species then
            remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "All 3 pets must be the same")
            return
        end
        table.insert(sizes, t:GetAttribute("AnimalSize") or 1)
    end

    local cost = 0
    for _, s in ipairs(sizes) do cost += Fuse.cost(zone, tier, s) end
    cost = math.floor(cost / #sizes + 0.5)
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < cost then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    if not _G.EggGrant then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "The Fuse Machine is not ready yet")
        return
    end

    local boost = (_G.GlobalBoost and _G.GlobalBoost.value and _G.GlobalBoost.value("luck")) or 1
    local size = Fuse.rollSize(sizes, rng)
    local luck = Fuse.rollLuck(tier, sizes, boost, rng)
    local granted = pcall(_G.EggGrant, plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    if not granted then
        remote:FireClient(plr, "deny", "Fusing failed, nothing was taken")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", math.max(0, (P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0) - cost))
    for _, t in ipairs(picked) do
        forgetPet(prof, t)
        t:Destroy()
    end

    remote:FireClient(plr, "fused", {
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, species = species, luck = luck, cost = cost,
    })
end)
